intent: first exploratory low-speed external aerodynamic calculation on a simplified A321-derived airframe

future_flow_proposal.velocity_formula: U=(V*cos(alpha),0,V*sin(alpha)) in body axes; positive alpha is upward relative flow
future_flow_proposal.turbulence_proposal: kOmegaSST, wall treatment and first-cell spacing selected jointly after geometry acceptance
future_flow_proposal.reference_area_status: must measure and lock a planform definition; no assumed OEM coefficient reference

geometry_trial.purpose: coarse airframe-only surface preparation feasibility; not a clean A321 performance geometry
geometry_trial.budget_note: research trial triage only; not an aerodynamic accuracy or manufacturing tolerance

stop: before CUDA/GPU probe, solver, mesher or validation suite; stage 6 requires a new execution decision
